name: @uione/compiler
description: The uione compiler, built for the browser and run in a Web Worker: check a project, build it, and see what each line becomes.
author: Daher Alfawares

scripts.wasm: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['one.mjs','one.wasm']){const from='../../compiler/build-wasm/'+f;if(!fs.existsSync(from)){console.error('the browser build is missing; run tools/wasm/build first');process.exit(1)}fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,'dist/'+f)}"
